children: On Sep 21, 2026, Riot Platforms fully prepaid all amounts outstanding under its Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Coinbase Credit, terminating the secured term loan facility of up to $200 million. The payoff satisfied all obligations and released the lender’s security interests over pledged assets, including bitcoin, USDC, and cash. No early termination fees were incurred. The move simplifies Riot’s capital structure and removes encumbrances on its financial assets.
